# CumpleClick Copilot instructions

Read `../AGENTS.md` and the three canonical docs before changes. Target PHP 8.0+
and an independent MySQL DB. Do not expose PINs, hashes, IPs, physical paths or
secrets; do not construct public URLs from request Host. Keep Baloo 2 self-hosted,
frames server-owned and image prompts camouflaged by physical traits only.
